Name: Jinja Furniture
Author: Skalanis
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Diese Mod fügt Robin's Shop Jinja Möbel hinzu, sowie zwei Tapeten und einen Bodenbelag zu Pierre's Katalog.
This mod adds and Jinja themed Furniture to Robin's Shop, as well as two wallpapers and one flooring to Pierre's Catalogue.
